title: gastrolobium rigidum
intro: Gastrolobium rigidum, commonly known as Stinking Roger, is a plant species native to Western Australia, characterized by its distinctive strong odor when damaged. It has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating wounds and infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the growth of new tissue and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified through phytochemical analysis.
